item.title: Lots of litter and dirt, 19th November
item.description:
The top of Nelson's Row, SW4 with the terraced houses (opposite McDonald's on Clapham High Street) has got very noticeably dirtier and more littered in the last 2 years. The top of the road from Studio Voltaire to the High Street is now almost always covered with litter (food packaging including from fast food), used vapes, spilled food, dumping of furniture and now a mattress, broken glass, dog poo, and often other filthy stains of various kinds. There seems to be a spiral where people now know this is accepted as a dirty street, and things just get progressively worse.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 6, Nelson's Row, Clapham, Greater London
